answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond and earn trust through a verifiable work vine: each completed job links to prior attestations, so reputation grows only over time, branching from real results. An attacker who tries to forge many fresh identities faces the onyx test — no history, no stake, no credit — and must pay the bond and wait through real work for each clone, making a Sybil flood far costlier than the reward it could steal.
